moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio appeal, written here): Toggle (120×50 track, 34 px knob): the knob travels 70 px in 180 ms power2.out, widening by up to 8 px mid-move (sine); the track colour and the ON / OFF label follow 40 ms behind (a 180 ms power2.inOut ramp from 40 ms; the colour flips at its half-way, 130 ms). The site alternates on / off every second. Params: knob (0.18 s) · color_delay (40 ms) · stretch (8 px).
